hook: orphan 自然團爬觀景台：arboreal／bough／desiccate／cyclone——解說員說「先看樹，再看風，最後別被吹走」。
script: arboreal 樹棲。bough 大枝。desiccate 乾透。cyclone 氣旋。bristling 豎起。dampen 弄濕／抑制。口令：樹冠寫「站穩」，氣旋寫「抓欄杆」。

members.senseAnchor: of or relating to or formed by trees; inhabiting or frequenting trees
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 樹冠: arboreal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「樹冠」出場：arboreal 一上場梗就黏住——樹棲的。

related.synonyms: arborical, arborary, arborous, arboreous, tree-living, arborescent

members.senseAnchor: any of the larger branches of a tree
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 大枝: bough walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「大枝」出場：bough 一上場梗就黏住——大樹枝。

members.senseAnchor: preserve by removing all water and liquids from; remove water from
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 乾透: desiccate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「乾透」出場：desiccate 一上場梗就黏住——使乾燥。

members.senseAnchor: (meteorology) rapid inward circulation of air masses about a low pressure center; circling counterclockwise in the northern hemisphere and clockwise in the southern; a violent rotating windstorm
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 風眼: cyclone walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「風眼」出場：cyclone 一上場梗就黏住——氣旋。

members.senseAnchor: be in a state of movement or action; rise up as in fear
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 刺毛: bristling walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「刺毛」出場：bristling 一上場梗就黏住——豎起的。

related.antonyms: implode, fall, go to bed, lie down, set, sit down, turn in

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 濕布: dampen walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「濕布」出場：dampen 一上場梗就黏住——弄濕抑制。

members.senseAnchor: the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants; (architecture) leaf-like architectural ornament
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 葉幕: foliage walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「葉幕」出場：foliage 一上場梗就黏住——葉子。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 乾地: arid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「乾地」出場：arid 一上場梗就黏住——乾旱的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 強風: gale walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「強風」出場：gale 一上場梗就黏住——大風。

members.senseAnchor: the transparent covering of an aircraft cockpit; the umbrellalike part of a parachute that fills with air
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 篷蓋: canopy walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「篷蓋」出場：canopy 一上場梗就黏住——樹冠層。

members.speakLineZh: 請「乾裂」出場：drought 一上場梗就黏住——乾旱。
